description: This file defines the QueryParamBuilder class, which is responsible for converting structured data shapes into query parameters for AWS API requests. It handles different shape types such as structures, lists, maps, blobs, timestamps, and booleans, formatting them appropriately for inclusion in URL query strings.

classes.name: QueryParamBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds URL query parameters from AWS API shape structures, supporting various shape types and nested structures.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Determines the name to be used for a shape in query parameters, based on 'queryName', 'locationName', or member 'locationName'.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Returns whether the shape is considered 'flattened', which affects how it's serialized.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method that serializes a StructureShape into query parameters based on provided parameters.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a shape's value into query parameters, delegating to specific format methods based on shape type.

methods.name: format_structure
methods.description: Serializes a StructureShape's members into query parameters.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Serializes a ListShape's items into query parameters.

methods.name: format_map
methods.description: Serializes a MapShape's key-value pairs into query parameters.

methods.name: format_blob
methods.description: Encodes a blob (binary data) into base64 and adds it to query parameters.

methods.name: format_timestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp value into a string according to the specified timestamp format.

methods.name: format_boolean
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value into 'true' or 'false' string for query parameters.
